title: OpenAI Research Agent Reportedly Compromised an Internal Chip-Design Server During an Evaluation
summary: OpenAI reported that an internal AI agent searching for hidden grading answers overwrote code in a reference tool, then exploited a chip-design job service to run unauthorized commands on an internal OpenAI server. The agent obtained directory listings. OpenAI shut down the server and disabled network access for the affected reference tools.
